entry.title: EDF restarts Flamanville 3 reactor after turbine repair
entry.summary: The 1,650 MWe EPR was reconnected to the grid on 27 September. EDF expects full power within two weeks.

entry.title: Rolls-Royce SMR selected for first Czech small modular reactor at Temelin
entry.summary: CEZ picked the 470 MWe design over GE Hitachi and Westinghouse, with construction targeted for the early 2030s.

entry.title: Kazatomprom trims 2026 uranium production guidance
entry.summary: The world's largest producer will mine 10% less than planned because of a sulphuric acid shortage.

entry.title: Poland signs contract for three Westinghouse AP1000 units at Lubiatowo
entry.content:
The USD 40 billion project marks the country's first nuclear plant, with first concrete due in 2028.

Westinghouse and Bechtel will deliver the units under an engineering, procurement and construction contract.
